Warm paws, calm flights

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the handoff smooth from booking to pickup, with a welfare coordinator checking comfort notes and practical needs along the way. <<FACT F048>> The team also stays alert to crate fit, quiet spacing, and gentle pacing so pets and people feel looked after.

On board, care stays steady and simple, and <<FACT F049>> <<FACT F042>> That mix of watchfulness and kindness helps every trip feel less stressful, especially when a nervous animal needs a little extra reassurance. Small checks, steady voices, and clear follow-through make a real difference for our travelers and their companions.
